methods.name: Multi-level Features Effective Weighting and Fusion (MFEWF) network
methods.summary: A deep learning network for landslide detection that integrates a Deep Residual Network (DRN) backbone, an Attention Modulation Module (AMM) for low-level features, a Coordinate Attention Atrous Spatial Pyramid (CAASP) module for high-level features, and a Multi-scale Feature Fusion Resampling Module (MFFRM) to fuse multi-level features for precise landslide boundary identification.
methods.verbatim: The training and independent testing SAR data of ETLs, the ground truth and the code of the deep learning network are available at https://github.com/ChenLifu2022.
